metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1027.011 (Fileless Storage). Adversaries may store data in "fileless" formats to conceal malicious activity from defenses. Fileless storage can be broadly defined as any format other than a file. Common examples of non-volatile f
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1027" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-029
